On reflection, my primary impulse  Is that it is an under known work of art. Like the... Last Express. A lot of love was poured into it. And... Yet it's not widely known. Like Tetris, sure. Everyone knows Tetris. Tetris has been done and redone to death. Below the route deserves to exist over decades, not just a few years like it did. Both the books, the series, which are very much from the 70s, and the game, which is a really wonderful... interpretation of the books. I really like puzzle games where the... a fundamental mechanic. is used to solve a puzzle. It's not arbitrary, it's how the world is constructed. And there is at least one point in here. That is like that. And there are so many little rules that make the world just come together. Like... If you kill a lap at a little bun-like creature... I think a lot of love is poured into this game and it deserves to be... remembered. carried forward. I think my greatest hope would be that some people are like, hey, this actually is a really sweet little thing. Can we make some pixel art to... make it be a more modern accessible game? Like, it really is not accessible. Mag4 games are not accessible. But Mag5 game might be. And so what if we did make it 320x200x256 with some better pixel art? And what if we did update the music? Like, there's a lot here. That we could do. But the core structure of the game is great. So I don't need to think we need to do all of everything over again.
